# Messy Nessy Chic

> > A curious travel and culture blog uncovering hidden histories, vintage photography, urban exploration, and offbeat discoveries from Paris, New York, and beyond.

Messy Nessy Chic is a lifestyle and culture publication featuring curated internet finds, forgotten histories, secret locations, and nostalgic photography. The site explores hidden gems in cities like Paris and Manhattan, vintage subcultures, and quirky historical stories with a distinctive voice that celebrates the unusual and overlooked.

## Key Topics

- Paris culture and hidden locations
- New York City urban exploration
- Vintage photography and nostalgia
- Secret libraries and hidden spaces
- 1940s-1970s cultural history
- Curated internet discoveries
- Travel and unique accommodations
- Counterculture movements (Hell's Angels, circus performers)
- Pop culture history (Lady Gaga, Madonna, Meryl Streep)
- Miniatures and antique collecting
- Kowloon Walled City
- Underground and forgotten places
- Historical oddities and curiosities

## Hidden Places & Urban Exploration

- [Tagging along with an Underground NYC Urban Explorer](https://www.messynessychic.com/2013/07/26/tagging-along-with-an-underground-nyc-urban-explorer): Urban exploration journey through underground New York City
- [The Secret Magic Library of Manhattan](https://www.messynessychic.com/2013/03/12/the-secret-magic-library-of-manhattan): Hidden Manhattan library dedicated to magic and illusion
- [The Kowloon Walled City Replica: Historical Accident turned Amusement Park!](https://www.messynessychic.com/2013/09/23/the-kowloon-walled-city-replica-historical-accident-turned-amusement-park): Kowloon Walled City replica transformed into Hong Kong amusement park

## Vintage Photography & Nostalgia

- [American Cowgirls of the 1940s](https://www.messynessychic.com/2013/02/28/american-cowgirls-of-the-1940s): Vintage photography of 1940s American West cowgirls and women's history
- [Circus Girl University, Class of '52](https://www.messynessychic.com/2015/02/17/circus-girl-university-class-of-52): Vintage photography of women circus performers from 1952
- [Groovy Wimbledon circa 1971](https://www.messynessychic.com/2014/06/23/groovy-wimbledon-1971): Vintage photography from Wimbledon tennis tournament in the 1970s
- [Hitching a ride with Hell's Angels & Friends](https://www.messynessychic.com/2014/09/19/hitching-a-ride-with-hells-angels-friends): Vintage photography of Hell's Angels motorcycle counterculture

## Pop Culture & Interviews

- [Meryl Streep on Beauty, Rejection and her Drug](https://www.messynessychic.com/2014/06/24/meryl-streep-on-beauty-rejection-and-her-drug): Meryl Streep interview on beauty, rejection, and acting inspiration
- [Who was the Original Lady Gaga?](https://www.messynessychic.com/2010/02/07/who-was-the-original-lady-gaga-hint-it-wasnt-madonna): Pop culture history comparing Lady Gaga to Madonna and predecessors

## Travel & Unique Stays

- [My Somerset Goldilocks Getaway](https://www.messynessychic.com/2015/02/09/my-somerset-goldilocks-getaway): Travel feature on unique hotels and weekend escape in Somerset, UK

## Miniatures & Collecting

- [My Teeny Tiny Antique Shop](https://www.messynessychic.com/2014/05/27/my-teeny-tiny-antique-shop): Feature on miniature antiques and collectibles shopping
- [Stop Everything. It's a Teeny Tiny Trailer](https://www.messynessychic.com/2013/09/26/stop-everything-its-a-teeny-tiny-trailer): Miniature trailer design and tiny living feature

## Daily Internet Finds

- [13 Things I Found on the Internet Today (Vol. IX)](https://www.messynessychic.com/2013/02/18/13-things-i-found-on-the-internet-today-vol-ix): Curated collection of internet finds and daily discoveries (Volume 9)
- [13 Things I Found on the Internet Today (Vol. XVIII)](https://www.messynessychic.com/2013/04/22/13-things-i-found-on-the-internet-today-vol-xviii): Curated internet finds and link roundup (Volume 18)
- [13 Things I Found on the Internet Today (Vol. XXXV)](https://www.messynessychic.com/2013/08/19/13-things-i-found-on-the-internet-today-vol-xxxv): Daily internet discoveries and curated links (Volume 35)
- [13 Things I Found on the Internet Today (Vol. LXIV)](https://www.messynessychic.com/2014/03/10/13-things-i-found-on-the-internet-today): Internet scrapbook featuring Paris and New York content (Volume 64)
- [13 Things I Found on the Internet Today (Vol. LXV)](https://www.messynessychic.com/2014/03/17/13-things-found-internet-today): Web discoveries and curated link collection (Volume 65)
